title: Combined sync reports success after local apply failures
reasoning: tryCombinedSync catches failures from applying config, feeds, digests, and schedules, logs them, and still returns true. performFullSync then skips fallback, sets lastSyncTime, and leaves lastSyncError nil. A database/settings write failure can therefore leave local state partially stale while the app records a successful sync.
reproduction: Make feedRepository.upsertAll or settingsRepository.setEnabledPeriods throw during a combined sync response. tryCombinedSync logs a warning, returns true, and performFullSync records success without fallback or surfaced error.
recommendation: Track apply failures and return false or throw when any required local apply step fails. Only mark lastSyncTime after the full local transaction succeeds; consider making optional sections explicit rather than silently swallowing all handler errors.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The linked tests cover model decoding and repository basics, but none instantiate GhostwriterSyncCoordinator or simulate local persistence failures during combined sync.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a coordinator test with a successful /sync response and a feed/settings repository stub that throws, asserting lastSyncError is set and lastSyncTime is not advanced.
minimumFixScope: GhostwriterSyncCoordinator.tryCombinedSync error propagation and coordinator-level tests for partial apply failures.
